name: zdeclient_qsand_create_feature_struct_from_event_template
description: zDEClient_QSand::CreateFeatureStructFromEventTemplate allocates a quicksand feature, copies the event template, allocates points and clip output, and fills default materials when needed.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient quicksand/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4563d0 validates allocating and zeroing the 0x50-byte feature, featureType 3, copying the 0x2c-byte event template, allocating zVec3[pointCount], creating the clip-patch output, and filling material/materialCycle from globals when feature flags request texturing and the template material is null.

The native zDEClient feature leaf smoke verifies feature type, template copy, default quicksand material/cycle substitution, point allocation, clip output allocation, and null initial featureGridCell.
